# `tcp` check

Connect to a TCP port; optionally require it to be closed or to send a banner.

```yaml
checks:
  example:
    type: tcp
    target: db.internal:5432
    expect:
      latency: { warn: 200ms, fail: 1s }
```

## Keys

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `target` **(required)** | string |  | host:port to connect to. |
| `expect` | mapping |  | What counts as healthy. |
| `expect.open` | bool | `true` | true: the port must accept connections. false: the port must refuse or not answer (e.g. a firewalled admin port). |
| `expect.banner_contains` | string |  | Text the server must send right after connecting (e.g. 'SSH-2.0', '220 '). |
| `expect.latency` | {warn, fail} duration |  | Connect time limits. Triggers when the value is above the threshold. |

Every check also accepts the [common keys](../config.md#common-check-keys).

One-liner: `medic check tcp <target> [--set key=value ...]`
